reason: Implement scanner/probe/playback/Emby/HLS changes against the active media metadata contract: Media vs MetadataItem ownership, STRM target probing, sibling PlaybackInfo scheduling, MediaSource identity, visible Media.ID resolution, and required playback tests.
Implementation spans ffprobe -> typed document -> database -> service -> Emby/API/frontend/backfill/HLS boundaries; keep one explicit data-flow contract and boundary validation model.
Avoid duplicated parsers, ad hoc JSON readers, repeated selection parsing, and split persistence paths; use existing/shared owners before adding new helpers.
